name: Valora
_turns: How many turns a game lasts (the arena doc); the turn track at the table's end has a slot for each.
_grid: One character per tile, row 0 = the far side (player 2), last row = player 1's side. Each character is defined in the legend. From a photo of the user's drawn board (mapstomake/valora.webp, taken from player 2's side: turned 180 degrees and perspective-straightened): a steel floor with walls two levels tall, five gears (three 4x4 turning counter-clockwise with a capture zone in the middle, numbered 1-3; two 3x3 turning clockwise), and blockers that gears 1-3 open and close.
_legend: level = height step (0 = lowest); tiles interact only within 1 level. surface picks the look from the palette. solid = nothing can stand on or cross it (no snap point). marker = something on the tile (painted, or a 3D piece with piece: true). g/z = gear tiles: a gear's plate (tools/place_pieces.py, from "gears") lies over them and carries their snap points (snap: false); z = a capture zone on a gear (its frame lifted onto the plate). a/b/c = blockers opened and closed by gear 1/2/3 (a steel block, closed at the start; the board shows a hazard frame under it).
_gears: Each gear: its top-left tile [row, col], size (3 or 4 tiles), which way it turns seen from above (ccw / cw) and its number (0 = none; a numbered gear opens and closes its blockers). Its plate shows the arrows (tools/build_pieces.py gear_arrow), the same as on the user's board.
_board: The published board files the map picker uses (from tools/build_board.py; update when a new version is published), then run tools/build_arena_index.py.
_table: Image for the table around the board (placeholder until the arena gets its own).
_textures: Placeholders from tools/draw_placeholders.py: steel tread plate floor, iron wall tops and sides.
